cases.scope: Composes exact private VM-memory prefix, configured root/non-root P0/log rollback and concurrent finite global registration/publication relations. Fixed policy0 includes publication allocation failure after ready P0, returning through P0 sync/memory/log rollback before VM memory/log and global cleanup. All configuration/failure choices retained; progress checked across all four policies. Fresh constructor, initially ready global prefix, returning allocators/destructors, P0 memory/log callee and heap lifetime contracts assumed. Registration has three slots and succeeds; sequential consistency and atomic vm_list_mut critical sections. Excludes C weak-memory/signal readers, retirement, arbitrary recursive GC, early global initialization failures, semantic C refinement and whole native/bootstrap/Gerbil admission. Execution partitions the four disjoint immutable policy choices, with the original full configuration/failure domains unchanged. Safety/progress is admitted for fixed policy0; policies1/2/3 have expected negative safety controls and separate complete progress-only checks. Their union is the original initConstructor domain. No fairness, state-space constraint, role bound or deadline expansion. Immutable module instance for policy 0. No shared action initializer helper; all four instance domains exhaust the original immutable policy choices. Quint 0.33 rejects nested imported aliases when instantiating this module. The executable sibling is mechanical monomorphization: only the module name and immutable policy-domain literal differ from the source template; regression checks enforce exact body equality. No shared initialization helper or instance wrapper executes.
